info.title: Wheelwright v2 account evidence and Positions
info.description: Bounded source retention, exact-row evidence admission and Position reads. No sophisticated historical reconciliation or recommendations. Canonical opaque resource identities, Account discovery and authorized-scope collections; persistence structure does not determine URI hierarchy. First-class User identity, authenticated self inspection and explicitly administrator-only User discovery; fixed many-to-many User–Account authorization.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Single optional UUID; invalid or repeated values are 422 after authorization. Blank generates one.

get.description: Pure committed backend snapshot read. Latest export date then admission time. No provider contact, lifecycle inference, body, pagination or acquisition. Position identity denotes observed contract/custody inventory or explicit snapshot association, not lifecycle continuity. Constituents appear exactly once. Missing fields remain null. Bid/ask and per-option broker margin requirements may use an accepted same-day Option Summary; each carries separate artifact/row provenance. Strategy rows never count inventory. Option Greeks, allocation, close policy and working orders remain unknown. Date-only evidence does not establish current executable prices or adjusted deliverables. Original bytes resolve through artifactId. Collections include only backend-authorized Account scope. Optional accountId narrows that scope and cannot expand authority. Account relationships are in representations, not URI ancestry. Aliases are never accepted as IDs. Bearer credentials resolve to stable Users; permissions are read from committed backend User authority, independently of credential strings or Account ownership. Tastytrade API holdings carry additive observation provenance and have no inferred opening economics, grouping, Program or orders. No retained CSV market enrichment is applied to tastytrade observations.

post.description: Transactionally retain exact bytes and original filename before parsing. Same account/hash reuses generated immutable artifact identity; every upload records a filename/processing attempt. REJECTED processing is HTTP 200, source survives and prior admitted evidence remains. Positions admit snapshots. Other files admit source-row observations; History appends/matches exact row occurrences without deleting prior observations. Corrections, lifecycle projection and continuous-history coverage are unresolved. Interrupted calls may leave PENDING; inspect inventory then retry retained processing. File-type/source-period interpretations are bounded; filename account attribution is qualified when History/Balances omit account ID. Content/admission deduplicates; import-attempt identities do not. Import requires artifact write authority for the target Account only. Exact mixed-account originals are retained privately. Positions processing admits only target-account rows and does not grant access to other Accounts. Formats without supported row-level Account attribution are retained with REJECTED processing rather than admitting mixed rows. Complete original-file retrieval separately requires artifact read authority for every source Account; unregistered source scopes deny retrieval. Collections include only backend-authorized Account scope. Optional accountId narrows that scope and cannot expand authority. Account relationships are in representations, not URI ancestry. Aliases are never accepted as IDs. Bearer credentials resolve to stable Users; permissions are read from committed backend User authority, independently of credential strings or Account ownership.

Exact source/evidence identities make admission repeatable; prior statuses and source remain retained. Import requires artifact write authority for the target Account only. Exact mixed-account originals are retained privately. Positions processing admits only target-account rows and does not grant access to other Accounts. post.summary: Acquire one complete tastytrade Account holdings observation
post.description: Explicit backend-only OAuth and holdings acquisition. Exactly one canonical accountId selector, no request body or other query. Authentication then exact Account acquisition authority before source/storage access. Account reads, artifact writes, quote acquisition and ID possession do not grant acquisition. Unconfigured provider or unsupported brokerage is 503. No orders/history/quotes/scheduler. Successful JSON bodies pass credential-safety checks before immutable exact-byte retention. Interpretation is all-or-nothing; accepted snapshot and attempt outcome commit together. Failed refresh preserves previous evidence and its clock. Pagination requiring more than one page is retained/rejected rather than misreported as complete. OAuth responses, headers and upstream errors are not retained or disclosed. Every response has X-Request-Id and private,no-store.

200.description: Completed synchronous attempt, including controlled FAILED or REJECTED outcomes. Only ACCEPTED advances the retained holdings observation.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credentials identify a stable immutable User. Committed backend User state authorizes resource access; IDs and client filters confer no authority. users.admin is an explicit backend privilege, not implied by Account access.

evidenceDate.description: Fidelity export day, or UTC backend receipt day for tastytrade. Not an opening or broker event timestamp.

PositionCollection.description: Positions with their account relationship and account snapshot evidence context; a constituent is counted once within its account.

positionsAcquire.description: Explicit Account acquisition capability; independent of metadata, Position reads, artifacts and quotes. Defaults false on migration.

UserAccountAccess.description: One explicitly established backend User–Account relationship; multiple Users may access one Account and one User may access multiple Accounts.

User.description: Stable backend-generated User identity, independent of Account IDs and credential rotation. No credential or bootstrap subject is exposed. Administrator privilege enables User inspection only; Account capabilities remain separately authorized.

HoldingsObservation.description: Backend request/receipt interval, not a package valuation clock or atomic brokerage event timestamp. No history-completeness claim.
